There are several methods of phase coding in computer holograms.

in example;

1) using reference wave - exact simulation of recording optic holograms, and creating interference pattern.

2) some old-type binary holograms easy to fabricate. Lohmann's method, Lee's method

There is also "iterative fourier transform method". I know more-less how it works. But I have no idea why such a method is popular. What is the advantage of IFT over computation using reference wave... 

Can anyone write me why there is a need of using iterative algorithm?

Isnt it easier (faster) to compute wavefront at the hologram plane, and just add reference beam?

Thanks ^^

M.
